help.intro: Find the next step for your account and recommendations.
help.loginTitle: How to sign in to FAVX
help.loginBody: Enter your email on the login screen. Enter the code from the most recent email. Check spam if the email does not arrive. Never share your login code.
help.profileBody: Open My profile and add your photo, name, bio and socials. Save your changes and check the preview. You control whether the profile is public; sharing a link does not publish a private profile.
help.postsBody: In Creator studio, choose Create recommendation. Add images and text, organize details and review the preview. Drafts stay private. Publishing requires confirmation and a public profile. Hiding a post removes it from visitors’ view.
help.mediaBody: In the editor, choose Add images or Take photo. Use JPG, PNG or WebP up to 20 MB. Wait for upload and processing to finish. If it fails, select Try again. The first image is the cover; you can reorder images. Originals stay private.
help.empty: No articles found. Try another word or contact support.
